summary: Iteration 25 — Evidence Metrics Engine™, Founder Beta Status™, and Universal Connector Framework™ tested end-to-end. All 18 backend pytest cases and all frontend flows PASSED. Revenue is real ($14.99 from 1 paid Stripe TEST order) — no synthetic 11,450 anywhere. Provenance badges (LIVE/TEST/NOT TRACKED YET) render correctly, drilldown modals load real records or honest empty states, Beta Status panel shows Founder Preview (Private Beta) with 19 Q&A items, and Connectors page reachable with 14 connectors and honest disabled-Publish reasons.

minor.issue: Products count differs between summary (117) and evidence records (122). Likely races (records added between calls) or count_documents vs find() nuance. Recommend using a single source of truth or fetching count from the same find() to preserve Treasure Standard™ consistency.

action_items: (Minor / optional) Align Products metric count with drilldown row count in metrics.py — either use len(find()) or fetch both from the same list to prevent 117-vs-122 style drift.
critical_code_review_comments: DrilldownModal in EvidenceDashboard.js does not reset `d` to null when metric.id changes. Since setActive(null) currently unmounts, this works today, but if the parent ever changes metric without unmounting, stale evidence would leak. Add `setD(null)` at the start of the useEffect for safety.
STRIPE_API_KEY is read once at import time in metrics.py — if env changes, the process must restart. Acceptable but worth documenting.

analytics.py still emits a synthetic knowledge_growth trend (base + i*3). Not part of this iteration, but for full Treasure Standard™ this should be moved to real time-series or flagged provenance=SIMULATED.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing data (1 paid $14.99 TEST Stripe txn, 117 products, 47 knowledge records, 32 published).
